messages.幼年期状態ではS1・S2で味方を回復・強化しながら「絶え間ない飢え」を溜め、「ラ: In Childhood, build Relentless Hunger while S1 and S2 heal and buff allies. Equip La Voracité to awaken Noble Dignity, then go on the offensive through Bleed and L'Abject. The usual pattern is roughly 3 turns supporting in Childhood before transitioning to Noble Dignity.
messages.双極性のS1・S2: 味方を対象にでき、S1「ラ・ピュルシオン」は味方の体力・精: **Duality S1 and S2**: They can target allies: S1 La Pulsion restores an ally's HP and SP, and S2 L'Appétit grants 1 Clash Power Up and 1 Desperate Hunger (plus 4 Charge Count for Charge Identities). If the target is a Le Rouge ally, S1's HP healing alone is replaced with "spend 20% HP and grant 2 Power Up" (the SP recovery still applies), and S2 spends 10% of their HP to additionally grant 2 Offense Level Up.
messages.絶え間ない飢えと高貴な品格: 脈動回数の消耗、味方の回復、味方の体力減少などで溜: **Relentless Hunger and Noble Dignity**: It builds through spending Pulsation Count, healing allies, reducing allies' HP, and more (up to 150, up to 50 per turn). If it is 100 or more at Turn End, the lower skill in his leftmost slot becomes La Voracité next turn, and at Combat Start the first time he equips it, he gains Noble Dignity (unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ). In Noble Dignity, his equipped basic skills change into dedicated skills and start inflicting the special Bleed L'Abject.
messages.脈動と暴走: 脈動は特殊充電(回数最大20)。戦闘終了時に暴走状態でなく脈動回数: **Pulsation and Uncontrollable Rampage**: Pulsation is a special Charge (up to 20 Count). At Combat End, if he is not in Uncontrollable Rampage and has 15 or more Pulsation Count, he spends all of it and gains 3 Uncontrollable Rampage next turn (raised Offense Level and Speed, no Stagger, and no death from Bleed, but he also gains Bleed). At Combat Start, the Defense skill La Fuite spends HP to raise Pulsation Count to 15 if he has no Rampage and less than 15 Count, so it likely serves as a way into Rampage.
messages.味方の体力消耗: 幼年期のS3「ル・バテーム・ルージュ」は戦闘開始時に味方2名の: **Draining allies' HP**: Childhood's S3 Le Baptême rouge spends 15% HP from 2 allies at Combat Start (prioritizing Le Rouge members, 25% for them). In Noble Dignity, Je m'abjecte spends 15% HP from 2 allies and La Voracité from 3 allies before attacking. La Castration (which it turns into at 150 Hunger) spends 50% of a Le Rouge ally's current HP to grant 3 Uncontrollable Rampage. Through the passive La Moisson, allies are never staggered or brought below 1 HP by the costs from this Identity's basic skill effects.
messages.序盤はS1・S2で味方を支援しつつ飢えを溜め、高貴な品格に移ってから出血とラブジ: Early on, support allies with S1 and S2 while building Hunger, then attack with Bleed and L'Abject after moving into Noble Dignity. He has many effects that drain allies' HP, and Le Rouge allies (currently Ishmael's Haute Couture:: Boutique du Rouge) take those costs first. If there are not 3 or more other Le Rouge allies, it is better to swap S3 (which drains 2 allies' HP) for his Defense skill (Evade). If he unintentionally changes into Noble Dignity in that state, also swap S2 for a counter along with S3. With a full set of Le Rouge allies, the usual flow of moving into Noble Dignity and attacking works fine.
